title: Brain null card / survival card
description: The smallest public, citable unit of Brain (Section 10.3). One card per experiment, stored as NULL_CARDS/<exp_id>.md with this field list. A survival card is a null card whose verdict is a rejected null; wins and nulls use the identical template. probe_dependency is REQUIRED: a card making a representational claim with no probe_dependency, or one citing a factor the atlas shows is not decodable, is INVALID. Form per BLACKHOLE.md: no em dashes, no agency/consciousness language.

hypothesis.description: The mechanism claim, engineering vocabulary only.

null_hypothesis.description: The pre-declared null this must beat, verbatim from the experiment.

baseline.description: The TUNED baseline, with the tuning named (cosine decay, optimizer, capacity-matched head). An untuned strawman voids the card.

ablation.description: The capacity/LR/seed ablation run and its outcome.

metric.description: frontier AUC | BWT | adaptation steps-to-threshold | ECE | recall@k | probe acc.

probe_dependency.description: REQUIRED. The atlas row (factor + encoder) the claim depends on, and its decodability. A representational claim whose probe_dependency is missing, or which cites a factor the atlas shows is not decodable, is INVALID (the claim is void and becomes a substrate bound, taxonomy entry 3).

atlas_row.description: Path to the atlas row backing this dependency, e.g. atlas/vjepa2_vitl_fpc64_256/identity.json.

decodable.description: From the atlas row. 'no' voids any representational claim built on this factor (the result is a substrate bound, not a mechanism result).

acc_above_chance.description: Probe accuracy minus chance floor, from the atlas row.

encoder_scale.description: Per-scale verdict required if it differs across L/H/g.

seeds.description: Fewer seeds than the measured sign-stability threshold (S>=3), or no SEM, voids the card.

provenance_tag.description: A tag richer than the cache supports voids the card (the cache validator refuses it).

taxonomy_category.description: 1..10 (Section 10.5 failure taxonomy) for a null; 'null rejected' for a survival card.

raw_run_id.description: The run hash + config path under runs/ that produced this. An id that does not reproduce within tolerance voids the card.
